trends.name: Iran Escalation Oil Surge
trends.summary: Brent crude surges above $110/barrel (+7%) following Trump's Iran war speech signaling imminent U.S. military action. Global shipping routes disrupted with tankers taking extreme detours; diesel futures hit $200/barrel in Europe. Geopolitical risk premium now dominates oil markets with Hormuz strait concerns driving supply uncertainty.

trends.name: Equity-Oil Decoupling Pattern
trends.summary: S&P 500 and crude oil moving in opposite directions in 76% of recent sessions (38 of 50 trading days)—highest divergence in 20+ years. Stock futures sinking on Iran war fears while oil rallies, suggesting equity market weakness despite oil gains. This breakdown of traditional hedging relationships signals deep market uncertainty.

trends.name: Nike Earnings Collapse
trends.summary: Nike ($NKE) posts second-largest loss in 25 years on earnings miss, signaling broader consumer discretionary weakness. Major bellwether for apparel/athletic retail sector at critical juncture with Trump administration policies affecting supply chains and tariffs.

trends.name: Jobs Data Softness Signals
trends.summary: February payroll expectations at 60k with 4.4% unemployment rate suggest significant labor market cooling ahead of Good Friday data release. ADP private payroll data and Challenger job cuts reports pending, critical for Fed rate-cut trajectory assessment.

trends.name: Supply Chain Cost Inflation
trends.summary: Global diesel scramble and shipping route disruptions driving 25%+ capex increases (Caterpillar planning $3.5B 2026 capex). Double DRAM and diesel costs creating inflationary pressures on equipment manufacturers and construction sector. Not-in-my-backyard constraints compounding supply challenges.

trends.name: AI Investment Race Heats Up
trends.summary: ARK Invest joins OpenAI latest funding round, betting on AI upside despite market skepticism. Franklin Templeton acquires digital assets firm for crypto/AI management. However, Huawei's cloud AI revenue decline shows U.S. rivals dominating; Chinese AI lagging signals geopolitical tech advantage shifting to Western players.

trends.name: Growth Stock Rally Lacks Conviction
trends.summary: Jim Cramer warns current rally lacks real leadership with AI-driven gains failing to inspire confidence across broader market. Snowflake rated 'cheap to watch, not to buy'—indicating AI/cloud stocks still richly valued. Divergence between megacap AI plays and market breadth warning of potential leadership vacuum.

trends.name: Dividend/Income Stock Positioning
trends.summary: Realty Income and dividend-focused strategies gaining traction (FTHI, FRA analyzed). Retail investor focus on monthly income strategies ($11.5k monthly withdrawal targets) as rate environment shifts. However, FRA downgraded on distribution sustainability concerns—warning signal for yield-heavy portfolios.

trends.name: Strategic Tech M&A Speculation
trends.summary: Globalstar stock surges 15% on Amazon acquisition speculation, signaling appetite for satellite/telecom assets. Rakuten hidden value thesis resurfaces amid consolidation rumors. Strategic tech consolidation trending as majors seek growth catalysts and spectrum/connectivity assets.

trends.name: Regional Banking Growth Play
trends.summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares positioned for continued healthy growth; Realty Income and selective regional banks added to 'fresh money' lists (Delta, Starbucks also flagged). Banking sector outperformance as rates stabilize and credit quality improves—contrasting with broader market uncertainty.

trends.name: Defense Spending Tailwinds
trends.summary: M-Tron Industries identified as hidden RF player in missile systems; India unveils AI loitering munitions. Geopolitical tensions (Iran, Middle East, Asia-Pacific) driving defense spending acceleration. Unmanned systems and advanced RF components seeing accelerated procurement cycles.

trends.name: International Currency Volatility
trends.summary: Japanese Yen index softening (73.67 vs 73.91) amid global macro uncertainty; UK-led Hormuz discussions signal geopolitical coordination. Currency divergence from oil shock suggesting emerging market stress potential. Yen weakness indicates Bank of Japan concerns on risk-off environment.
